newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 10.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 10. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The island resort of Bali was quiet on Wednesday when its inhabitants, who are mostly Hindu, celebrated the Hindu New Year. All the islands' tropical beaches were deserted and economic activities stopped for the day.

Foreign banks have said they will find it hard to comply with the government's ruling on small-business credit quotas because they have trouble assessing small companies. Bank Indonesia has made it compulsory for joint venture and foreign banks to lend to small businesses.
Polysindo Hong Kong Limited, an affiliate of PT Texmaco Jaya, is to acquire three million shares or 23 percent of Dyersburg's common stock at an average price of $7.65 per share.
